// diagnostic

E1106

`.detach()` called on a task that captured a `view` borrow.

What

`.detach()` called on a task that captured a `view` borrow.

Why

A detached task runs unsupervised and may outlive the borrow's source; the captured `view` would dangle.

Fix

Pass an owned `copy`, or a `Shared<T>` handle, to the task instead of a `view`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1106: tests/ui/task_detach_view_capture.stderr.

Error [E2305]: a returned view cannot borrow from a temporary argument
  --> tests/ui/task_detach_view_capture.jet:5:20
    |
  5 |     t :: task peek([1, 2, 3])
    |                    ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: the temporary owner is dropped at the end of this statement, while the returned view remains live
 Fix: store the owner in a named binding first, then pass that binding to the view-returning call
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2305

Error [E1102]: this task returns a view that cannot be shared — it does not live long enough to cross into a task
  --> tests/ui/task_detach_view_capture.jet:5:15
    |
  5 |     t :: task peek([1, 2, 3])
    |               ^^^^
 Why: a view is a borrow, not an owned value; tasks and channels move owned values between threads
 Fix: give the task plain owned data, or rebuild the value as an owned copy before spawning
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1102

Error [E1106]: can't detach task `t` — it captured a `view` borrow that may not live long enough
  --> tests/ui/task_detach_view_capture.jet:6:7
    |
  6 |     t.detach()
    |       ^^^^^^
 Why: a detached task runs unsupervised and may outlive the caller; a captured `view` would dangle
 Fix: pass an owned `copy`, or a `Shared<T>` handle, to the task instead of a `view`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1106
